CONFIDENTIAL
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch
REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No. S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 9547
Date October 26, 1939
Shaitonh

Subject Miss E.N. Grebennikoff.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by [Signature]

Inquiries show that house 1, passage 135 Avenue Haig has since 1-12-35 been rented by Mrs A.I. WITKOVSKY, 34, Russian, who is reported to be a widow. At present Mrs WITKOVSKY and her two children aged 11 and 10 years, respectively, occupy two rooms in the house the remaining four being occupied by the following tenants: a Russian musician and his common-law wife; a Russian woman reported to be a trained nurse by occupation; a Russian woman reported to be "kept" by a member of the U.S. Navy; a certain Miss E.N. GREBENNIKOFF.

According to her own statement when registering with the French Police on 24-2-38, Miss Evdokia Nikolaevna GREBENNIKOFF, Russian, was born on 14-3-1912 at Saratov, Russia, and has been residing in Shanghai for about 6 years. In the French Police registration form she gave her occupation as "home work" and in the house register filled in a few days ago described herself as a "typist". It appears that she is without any fixed employment. Discreet enquiries in the neighbourhood reveal that she is known to other people as the "fiancee of a British member of the Shanghai Municipal Police".

Miss GREBENNIKOFF is reported to have been residing at the above address since 26-4-37, her previous address being 159 Avenue Haig, House 8. She is not registered with the Russian Emigrants Committee, 118/1 Moulmein Road, nor with the Council of United Russian Organization (SORO), 8 Avenue Dubail.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
档案号 S. B. REGISTRY
编号 S. B. D. 9547
日期 1939年10月26日
Shaitonh（原文不清）

事由 E.N. Grebennikoff 小姐。

由特别调查员 Prokofiev 编制。呈报人 [签名]

经查，海格路（Avenue Haig）135弄1号自1935年12月1日起由 A.I. WITKOVSKY 太太承租。Witkovsky 太太，34岁，俄国人，据报为寡妇。目前，Witkovsky 太太及其两名分别为11岁和10岁的子女居住在该宅的两个房间内，其余四个房间由以下租客占用：一名俄国音乐家及其事实婚姻妻子；一名据报职业为受过训练的护士的俄国妇女；一名据报被美国海军某成员“包养”的俄国妇女；以及一位 E.N. GREBENNIKOFF 小姐。

根据 Evdokia Nikolaevna GREBENNIKOFF 小姐于1938年2月24日向法租界巡捕房登记时的自述，她系俄国人，1912年3月14日出生于俄国萨拉托夫（Saratov），已在上海居住约6年。在法租界巡捕房的登记表上，她将职业填写为“家庭作业”，而在几天前填写的住户登记簿中，她自称是“打字员”。看来她没有任何固定职业。经在邻里间谨慎查访，得知她在他人眼中被称为“上海公共租界工部局警务处一名英籍警员的未婚妻”。

据报，GREBENNIKOFF 小姐自1937年4月26日起居住于上述地址，其前住址为海格路159号8室。她未在莫尔尼路（Moulmein Road）118/1号的俄国侨民委员会注册，也未在杜拜路（Avenue Dubail）8号的俄国统一组织理事会（SORO）注册。
